proposed_prose.text_latex: Nix supports derivation-based builds, fixed and experimental floating content addressing, and rebuild checks; Bazel maps action hashes to cached results and stores outputs by content~\cite{nixdocs,bazeldocs}. SLSA build provenance binds artifact subjects to build definitions and builder identities~\cite{slsadocs}. RTL2GDSAGI applies these general mechanisms to a runtime release contract that binds native reports to selected GDS and deck bytes, invalidates affected cached evidence, and revalidates lineage and declared checker coverage.
proposed_prose.placement: Related Work after provenance/build baselines, or immediately after PROV context
proposed_prose.local_sentence_basis: main.tex Evidence Contract, selected-GDS/deck/report/lineage discussion; source-code and native-run verification outside this citation task
proposed_prose.qualification: Comparison concerns the evaluated integration; no novelty priority, absence of similar contracts elsewhere, full PDK hashing, determinism guarantee or SLSA conformance inferred.
